subject.title: feat(ui): path-based session and dashboard URLs

question: Should OpenClaw preserve already published session query URLs through a one-way canonical redirect, or intentionally break those released links in this UI routing change?
rationale: The branch documents the break as intentional, but existing browser bookmarks and ClickClack discussion links are a released user-facing contract; source review cannot determine whether maintainers accept that upgrade cost.

options.title: Add a one-way URL migration
options.body: Accept path URLs as canonical while translating released query-form session and face links to the new route without retaining them as a steady-state URL format.

options.title: Accept the intentional break
options.body: Land the removal and explicitly accept that existing bookmarks and published ClickClack links require manual replacement after upgrade.

recommendation.title: Add a one-way URL migration
recommendation.body: Accept path URLs as canonical while translating released query-form session and face links to the new route without retaining them as a steady-state URL format.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored and is assigned to the complete URL-contract proposal, including the stated intentional compatibility break.
